```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
print(schema(open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")))
```

```{r}
#| include: false
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
#| include: false
metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = as.Date(lubridate::parse_date_time(
    launch_date,
    orders = c("ymd", "B d, Y"),
    quiet = TRUE
  ))) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed)
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(category_share = category_market_cap / sum(category_market_cap)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(category_name, category_market_cap, .fun = median)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = category_share, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_rect(
    data = tibble(
      start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
      end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11"))
    ),
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey30",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = tibble(
      date = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
      y = c(1.04, 1.11),
      event = c("Luna/UST crash (May 7-12)", "FTX collapse (Nov 8-11)")
    ),
    aes(x = date, y = y, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis", name = "Category") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.17)) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto market-cap composition over time",
    subtitle = "Daily category shares of the combined market cap of coins in this dataset.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of market cap",
    caption = "Source: daily prices, coin metadata, and category lookup files."
  )
```
